capabilities: download remote images and media from pasted web content
localize attachments for the active note or the whole vault
save base64-embedded images and convert PNG to JPEG
disambiguation: Despite the name, it downloads and localizes any file types from web embeds, not only images.
extras: Warns that vault-wide processing can change all notes at once and recommends periodic backups; installation instructions require deleting previous versions first.
intentEvidence: A reincarnation of Local Images to download images in Markdown notes to local storage.
problem: Pasted web or Word content keeps image links pointing to remote hosts that can disappear, and managing embedded media in Obsidian means manual work for naming, duplicates and unused files.

relations.evidence: Remove obsidian-local-images plugin to avoid any conflicts.

summary: Downloads remote images and media from pasted web or document content into the vault, with template naming, MD5 deduplication and orphan cleanup.
